map.name: Copper Canopy: The Long Pursuit
map.description: Asymmetric pursuit across a flooded jungle outpost.

text.objectives: Hunter captures every scout; a scout who outlasts the clock escapes.
briefing: P1 controls the hunter; P2 and P3 control scouts.
Scouts may hide in any marked chamber. Capture requires both sides to enter the same chamber.
P1 receives 18 seconds to prepare; scouts win if any remains at 210 seconds.

messages.hunter_start: You are the hunter. Scouts have 18 seconds to hide.
messages.hider_start: Move to a chamber before the pursuit begins.
messages.hunt_started: Pursuit begins. Enter a chamber containing a scout to capture it.
messages.caught: Your signal is lost; the hunter found you.
